title: Optimal Multitask Representations Under a Rate Constraint: An Information Bottleneck Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.30493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Which pretraining objective yields the best representation for downstream tasks under an information budget? We formalize this problem as a multitask information bottleneck, using a mutual information constraint to model incomplete information retention. For Gaussian inputs and tasks, we characterize optimal representations and show that a weakly task-aligned specialist can outperform a reconstruction generalist at low rates but lose at high rates. We also construct task families for which every fixed Gaussian prediction objective incurs arbitrarily large relative regret, driven by reversals in optimal allocation priorities. Conversely, the average task information matrix defines an objective with a uniform relative-regret bound controlled by maximum task SNR. translated_title: 速率约束下的最优多任务表示：一种信息瓶颈分析
translated_abstract: 在信息预算约束下，哪种预训练目标能为下游任务产生最佳表示？我们将该问题形式化为一个多任务信息瓶颈问题，使用互信息约束来建模不完整的信息保留。对于高斯输入和任务，我们刻画了最优表示，并表明弱任务对齐的专家模型在低速率下可以优于重构通用模型，但在高速率下会落后。我们还构建了任务族，对于这些任务族，任何固定的高斯预测目标都会产生任意大的相对遗憾，这是由最优分配优先级的逆转所驱动的。相反，平均任务信息矩阵定义了一个具有统一相对遗憾上界的目标，该上界由最大任务信噪比控制。CelebA 和 dSprites 上的实验表明，压缩可以改变哪个预训练目标表现最佳，甚至任务感知训练也可能逆转哪个下游任务……
tldr: 该论文通过信息瓶颈框架分析信息预算约束下的最优多任务预训练表示，发现压缩程度会改变哪个预训练目标最优，且不存在在所有任务族上都表现一致的固定预测目标。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes optimal multitask pretraining representations under an information budget via an information bottleneck framework, showing that the compression level can change which pretraining objective performs best, and that no fixed prediction objective is uniformly optimal across all task families.
